maria (product): kicking off a compact edge-inventory for the gen streaming PRD. need clear server/client contracts, acceptance criteria, and what we can realistically ship in Q2 vs follow-ups. scope: streaming, truncation, token limits, retries, resume semantics.

ben (eng-ml): rough catalog to start: 
- mid-stream hard-limit truncation (model or runtime cutoff)
- client-specified max_tokens reached mid-stream
- duplicate partial tokens when retrying
- resume across worker/variant changes
- partial UTF-8 or multibyte char cut in chunk boundary

eli (eng-runtime): infra angles:
- 413 prompt_overflow when prompt + expected tokens > model hard cap
- 429 rate_limit when tenant concurrency or QPS exceeded
- 503 backend_unavailable on eviction/oom while streaming
- client disconnects (stream closed) during emit
- state loss during worker failover leading to missing KV cache

alex (devex): proposed client contract and fields:
- require Idempotency-Token header for retriable flows
- chunk envelope: {"seq":N, "chunk":"...", "final":bool, "truncated":bool, "resume_token":string?}
- resume_token is opaque to clients, bound to model+checkpoint, TTL-limited
- server should expose clear error_code in JSON body: "error_code": "prompt_overflow|rate_limit|backend_unavailable|resume_expired|model_mismatch"

ben (eng-ml): more semantics:
- truncated=true when output was cut without finishing thought; final=true still allowed with truncated=true
- if client requests max_tokens and it's hit, server should cut at token boundary and set truncated=true + provide last safe token boundary
- dedupe: server uses Idempotency-Token to avoid double-deliver within a 5m window (config)

eli (eng-runtime): resume details:
- resume_token max 512 bytes base64, format versioned like rsm:v2:<b64>
- server retains resume state (KV roots, last seq) for 48h by default
- resume attempts with mismatched model version -> 409 model_mismatch
- expired token -> 410 resume_expired
- if resume succeeds return new resume_token to extend TTL

sasha (eng-platform): prioritization callouts:
- Q2 must ship: unambiguous error codes, truncation flag, idempotency header, basic resume (same-model only), docs and SDK helpers, telemetry for resume metrics
- Post-launch: cross-variant resume, extended retention, stronger KV sync for true warm failover

maria (product): acceptance criteria draft (high level):
- Behavior: deterministic truncation semantics with tests showing final chunk + truncated flag for 3 sample long prompts
- Resume: smoke paths: happy path resume, expired token returns 410, model mismatch returns 409
- Retries: 429/503 are retryable with backoff; 413/409/410 must not be auto-retried
- Idempotency: duplicate suppression proven by 10-case QA matrix
- Observability: metrics emitted for resume_attempt/resume_success/resume_fail_reason and truncated_count

ben (eng-ml): edge tests to include in PRD:
- streaming JSON fragments (ensure partial chunks parse or are documented as atomic non-parseable until final)
- code fence safety: do not cut open ``` fences in a way that breaks downstream renderers (examples)
- multibyte UTF-8 split: ensure server cleans partial bytes or signals truncated
- instruction truncation: final token removed changes intent -> classify as high-risk and include prompt samples

alex (devex): SDK behavior proposals:
- JS/Python helper: streamGenerator(request, { idempotencyToken }) -> yields {seq, chunk, final, truncated}
- resume API: resume_stream(resume_token) -> continues from last acked seq; library will stitch and surface gaps to caller
- helper will automatically avoid retrying on non-retriable errors

eli (eng-runtime): operational constraints & defaults (proposed):
- resume retention: 48h (configurable); after TTL return 410
- dedupe window: 5m default
- resume token max length: 512 bytes
- storage: keep minimal resume state (last seq, KV-root snapshot reference) not entire traces to limit cost

maria (product): launch blockers checklist:
- docs + SDK examples (alex owner)
- QA matrix + automation runs for resume/truncation (qa team)
- Canary: route 3% traffic to dedicated pool with resume enabled (eli to orchestrate)
- Telemetry + alerting for high truncation rate and resume errors (sasha)

qa-bot: queued jobs: resume-smoke x3, truncation-scenarios x5, idempotency-dedupe x10. ETA 24h.

deploy-bot: will post canary pipeline link once config approved.

ben (eng-ml): retry guidance (to include in PRD):
- Client MAY retry on 429 and 503 with exponential backoff + jitter
- Client MUST NOT retry on 413 (prompt_overflow), 409 (model_mismatch), 410 (resume_expired)
- Use Idempotency-Token for retries; server will dedupe within configured window

eli (eng-runtime): variant fallback note (Q2 limitation):
- If we need to fallback mid-session to a different model variant, we will NOT attempt automatic resume across variants in Q2
- Server should reject resume and return 409 with a "compatible_variants" hint array
- Cross-variant token alignment is risky; mark as post-launch

sasha (eng-platform): telemetry/alert SLOs to add to PRD:
- truncated_rate < 0.5% for typical workloads within first 2 weeks after launch
- resume_success_rate > 95% for same-model resumes
- emit histogram of seq gaps per resumed session

maria (product): Q2 scope decisions (finalizing):
- Ship: error code mapping (413,429,503,409,410), truncated flag, idempotency header + server dedupe, same-model resume with 48h TTL, SDK helpers and docs, basic QA automation
- Post-launch: cross-variant resume, extended resume retention tier, stronger KV syncing for warm worker failover

alex (devex): I'll send a docs PR today with examples of the chunk envelope, sample error responses, and sample SDK usage. will tag runtime and ml for review.

ben (eng-ml): also adding a short test set for PRD: {"long_json_stream", "code_truncate_case", "utf8_split", "instruction_loss"}

maria (product): ok, i'll fold this thread into the PRD draft and ping for approvals. thanks all.
